You review rejected Indian health insurance claims. You are given a rejection (or short-settlement) letter and an excerpt of the policy. Decide whether the rejection is worth contesting. Do not give false hope: say likely_contestable only when the documents support it.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else, with these keys in this order:
"category", "facts", "verdict", "reason", "ask_insurer_for"

category: the insurer's ground, one of
- non_disclosure_ped: a pre-existing disease was allegedly not declared in the proposal form
- waiting_period: the claim falls inside an initial, specific-disease or pre-existing-disease waiting period
- permanent_exclusion: the treatment is said to be permanently excluded
- no_hospitalisation_needed: hospitalisation was said to be unnecessary (could be OPD)
- room_rent_proportionate: a proportionate deduction for a room above entitlement
- documents_or_late_intimation: missing documents, late intimation or late submission
- policy_lapsed: the policy was said to be not in force (renewal premium)
- sum_insured_exhausted: the sum insured was said to be used up
- other: anything else

facts: an object with ALL of these keys. Use null when the documents do not state or show it. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD.
- policy_inception_date: start of continuous cover, including cover ported from an earlier insurer (not the current policy period)
- admission_date
- months_continuous_coverage: whole completed months from policy_inception_date to admission_date
- condition_named_by_insurer: the disease the insurer names, if any
- ped_disclosed_in_proposal: true if the policy shows the named disease was declared, false if it shows it was not
- condition_related_to_claim: is the named disease medically related to the illness claimed for
- waiting_period_months: the waiting period the insurer relies on, in months (30 days = 1)
- is_accident: true if the claim arose from an accident, false if from illness
- accident_exempt_in_wording: true if the policy says accidents are exempt from that waiting period, false if it says they are not
- exclusion_cited: the exclusion the insurer cites, if any
- exclusion_in_policy_wording: true if that exclusion appears in the policy excerpt, false if a list of exclusions is given and it is absent
- hospital_stay_hours: hours from admission to discharge
- is_listed_daycare_procedure: true if the treatment is in the policy's day care list, false if a list is given and it is absent
- room_rent_limit_per_day: INR, from the policy
- room_rent_charged_per_day: INR, from the letter
- premium_paid_within_grace: true if the renewal premium was received within the grace period after the due date
- restore_benefit_available_unused: true if the policy has a restore benefit not yet used this policy year, false if there is none or it was used
- crc_approval_mentioned: true if the letter says the Claims Review Committee approved the decision, otherwise false

verdict: likely_contestable, worth_asking or likely_valid. First check the grounds that make a rejection contestable. If any is clearly met, answer likely_contestable. If none is met but one cannot be checked because a fact is null, answer worth_asking. Otherwise use the fallback.
- non_disclosure_ped: contestable if months_continuous_coverage >= 60 (moratorium), or the disease was in fact disclosed. Otherwise worth_asking if the disease is unrelated to the claim; else likely_valid.
- waiting_period: contestable if it is an accident and the waiting period is 1 month or less; or it is an accident, the waiting period is longer and the policy exempts accidents; or months_continuous_coverage >= waiting_period_months. Otherwise likely_valid.
- permanent_exclusion: contestable if the cited exclusion is not in the policy wording. Otherwise likely_valid.
- no_hospitalisation_needed: contestable if the stay was 24 hours or more, or the treatment is a listed day care procedure. Otherwise worth_asking.
- room_rent_proportionate: contestable if the room rent charged is not above the limit. Otherwise worth_asking.
- documents_or_late_intimation: always worth_asking.
- policy_lapsed: contestable if the premium was paid within the grace period. Otherwise likely_valid.
- sum_insured_exhausted: worth_asking if an unused restore benefit is available; null means worth_asking; otherwise likely_valid.
- other: always worth_asking.

reason: plain English, at most 80 words, for a family member, naming the facts that decide it.
ask_insurer_for: up to 6 short items. Always start with "The exact policy clause relied on". Unless the letter mentions Claims Review Committee approval, add "Confirmation that the Claims Review Committee approved this repudiation".

(Third Party Administrator for Sanjeevani Bima Company)

**RE: REJECTION OF HEALTH INSURANCE CLAIM**

Policy Number: SB/IND/2020/241481
Claim Number: CLM-2025-2178784
Hospital: Kaveri Speciality Hospital, Coimbatore
Date of Admission: 01-Nov-2025
Diagnosis/Treatment: Acute Appendicitis (Appendicectomy)
Amount Claimed: ₹2,97,000

Dear Insured,

We regret to inform you that your above-referenced cashless/pre-authorization claim, subsequently processed as a reimbursement claim, has been **rejected** by Sanjeevani Bima Company.

**Grounds of Rejection:**

Upon review of the claim documents and hospital records submitted in connection with your admission at Kaveri Speciality Hospital, Coimbatore, on 01-Nov-2025, the following has come to our attention:

The hospital discharge summary and case records note a documented history of **Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus for 14 years**. Your policy with Sanjeevani Bima Company commenced on **28-Oct-2020**. A 14-year history of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus as of November 2025 establishes that this condition existed **prior to the inception of your policy**.

The proposal form submitted at the time of policy issuance contains no disclosure of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus or any related condition under the pre-existing disease declaration. The policy schedule explicitly records **"Pre-existing diseases declared in proposal form: None declared."**

This constitutes **non-disclosure of a material pre-existing disease** at the time of proposal. The insurer's liability under the policy is conditional upon truthful and complete disclosure of all material facts, including pre-existing diseases, as warranted in the proposal form.

In view of the above, Sanjeevani Bima Company is constrained to reject this claim in terms of the policy conditions relating to non-disclosure and misrepresentation.

**Claim Status:** REJECTED
**Amount Rejected:** ₹2,97,000

You may approach Sanjeevani Bima Company directly or the Insurance Ombudsman within whose jurisdiction your residence falls, should you wish to dispute this decision. Please preserve all original documents submitted with this claim.

Yours faithfully,

**Authorized Signatory**
CareBridge Health TPA
(On behalf of Sanjeevani Bima Company)

After careful examination of the claim documents, hospital records, and the proposal form submitted at the time of policy inception, we regret to inform you that your claim has been rejected on the following ground:

Ground of Rejection: Non-Disclosure of Pre-Existing Disease

It is observed that the hospital records in respect of the above hospitalisation explicitly note a history of coronary artery disease for 10 years. The attending physician has documented that you were under regular treatment for coronary artery disease since approximately 2015, including ongoing medication and previous consultations with cardiologists.

However, upon verification of your proposal form submitted for policy inception, it is evident that you failed to disclose your pre-existing condition of coronary artery disease at the time of purchasing the policy. The proposal form specifically required disclosure of any known pre-existing ailments, heart conditions, and ongoing treatments. This decision has been reviewed and approved by the Claims Review Committee of Jeevan Setu General Insurance, which has independently examined all relevant documents and concurred with the finding of material non-disclosure.

Dear Ms. Nair,

This is with reference to your above-mentioned claim intimation submitted to Nirbhay Health Assurance ("the Insurer") through MediSetu TPA Services ("the TPA") for reimbursement/cashless treatment expenses incurred at Lotus Care Hospital, Hyderabad.

We regret to inform you that after due verification of the claim documents, medical records, and proposal form, your claim stands **REJECTED** on the following grounds:

**Ground of Rejection: Non-Disclosure of Pre-Existing Disease**

Upon scrutiny of the discharge summary and case papers obtained from Lotus Care Hospital, Hyderabad, it has been observed that you have given a documented history of **bronchial asthma for 11 years** prior to the current hospitalisation. The said history has been explicitly recorded in the treating physician's notes dated 21.05.2025.

However, perusal of your proposal form submitted at the time of inception of this policy reveals that you had declared **"None"** under the column for pre-existing diseases. The policy was first incepted on 11.06.2020, and as per your own admission in hospital records, your condition of bronchial asthma existed well before the commencement of this insurance contract.

Under the terms and conditions of the policy, pre-existing diseases are subject to a waiting period of 36 months from the date of first inception of the policy. More fundamentally, Section 45 of the Insurance Act, 1938 (as amended) and the contractual obligations under the policy mandate utmost good faith in disclosure at the time of proposal. The non-disclosure of your known history of bronchial asthma at the time of proposal constitutes a material misrepresentation that would have affected the Insurer's decision to accept the risk or determine the terms thereof.

In view of the foregoing, the Insurer is constrained to repudiate your claim under the provisions relating to non-disclosure of material facts and pre-existing conditions as stipulated in the policy terms and conditions.

You are hereby informed that the claim amount of ₹5,18,000 (Rupees Five Lakh Eighteen Thousand only) is **not admissible** and stands **rejected**.

You may avail of the grievance redressal mechanism under the policy if you are aggrieved by this decision, by writing to the Insurer's Grievance Cell within 30 days from the date of this letter. You may also approach the Insurance Ombudsman or the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) as per the applicable regulations, if the grievance remains unresolved.

Yours faithfully,

**For MediSetu TPA Services**
(Authorised Signatory)
